column1: # Indicators of compromise from public incident reports, used by the
# compromise module (Linux). One indicator per line, tab-separated:
# TYPE is "ip" (server the malware talks to; matched against established
# connections) or "sha256" (file hash; matched against loader files found in
# project folders). Add new incidents at the end, with a reference link.
# ── ChainDrop, August 2026: self-propagating npm/PyPI worm (Mini Shai-Hulud
# variant). Its loader setup.mjs is started by an npm preinstall hook and by
# ── wfx-loot, November 2026: CI secret stealer pushed through hijacked GitHub
# accounts (workflows, shell scripts, npm postinstall hooks).
